audit.why: FAV at 54.39% over 2576 games; Renekton owns every row until Maiden, which is exactly what the prose describes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagreed with the packet chart: Level 1, Levels 4-5 and Level 6 all said Skill, and 2+ items said Renekton.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Renekton for rows 0-5 and Yorick at 2+ items. The matchup's own 'early' opens 'You have the cleaner kit at every level here'; whys[3] tells you to force a trade every time the cage is down; whys[4] and mid call level 6 your absolute ceiling; whys[6] and late say Maiden makes the side lane a 2v1 you cannot win.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4 to Renekton and row 6 to Yorick, as matched pairs, with phases[4].why and phases[6].why restated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer has Yorick's slots systematically swapped: the cage is called 'E' or 'E Dark Procession' four times, Last Rites is called 'W', and Mourning Mist is called 'Q'.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Q Last Rites (auto reset, heals him, 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, digs a grave on champions), W Dark Procession (destructible wall, 20/18/16/14/12s, 600 range), E Mourning Mist (projectile, reduces armour, slows, marks you and speeds his summons toward the mark, 12/11/10/9/8s), R Eulogy of the Isles (Maiden, 160/130/100s).
audit.corrected: Cage is Dark Procession (W); the heal is Last Rites (Q); the mark/armour-shred is Mourning Mist (E).

audit.whatIsWrong: Last Rites was never identified as an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: It carries the autoReset flag, so the attack wind-up is the tell for his burst, not the cast.

edits.before: Dominus stats turn even fights into wins before 25 minutes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Yorick's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Dominus eats a ghoul swarm and Fury acceleration gives two empowered Ws — kill him before Eulogy of the Isles spawns Maiden.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Yorick carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Maiden plus a full ghoul wave makes the side lane a 2v1. Yorick carry threat 7/10 — rotate, do not duel his setup.

edits.before: E-in W-stun Q-heal before his E cage lands is your hardest early window — he has no answer to a clean stun-trade at level 2.
edits.after: E-in W-stun Q-heal before Dark Procession (W) lands is your hardest early window — he has no answer to a clean stun-trade at level 2.

edits.before: All three abilities online and his E on cooldown means he cannot cage you mid-combo; shove and deny his Q Mourning Mist sustain on the wave.
edits.after: All three abilities online and Dark Procession on cooldown means he cannot cage you mid-combo; shove and deny his Last Rites (Q) heal on the wave.

edits.before: You have the cleaner kit at every level here. At level 1 he wants to stack Mist with W Last Rites autos — respect his AA range but do not give him free stacks; match his autos and Fury up. At level 2 you spike harder than he does: E through him, W-stun before he can drop his E cage, Q-heal back. The critical habit is reading his E cast animation — if he drops Dark Procession first, hold your E and back off, because fighting inside the cage with three ghouls chewing you is a losing trade. Never dash in if his E is already on the ground.
edits.after: You have the cleaner kit at every level here. At level 1 he wants to stack Mist with Last Rites (Q) autos — respect his AA range but do not give him free stacks; match his autos and Fury up. At level 2 you spike harder than he does: E through him, W-stun before he can drop Dark Procession (W), Q-heal back. The critical habit is reading that cast — if the cage goes down first, hold your E and back off, because fighting inside it with three ghouls chewing you is a losing trade. It is 20s at rank 1, so wait it out.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 he starts building a real ghoul count, so the wave state matters. Shove him in when you have Fury stocked and deny the passive healing — his Q Mourning Mist is his main sustain tool and it heals off the wave, not just you. At level 6 Dominus is your absolute ceiling: the HP buffer eats a full ghoul-swarm hit, Fury accelerates so you get two empowered Ws in one all-in, and he has no escape dash to break the pattern. Ult into him before Maiden spawns if possible — a Yorick without Maiden is just a slow melee with a cage.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 he starts building a real ghoul count, so the wave state matters. Shove him in when you have Fury stocked and deny the healing — Last Rites (Q) is his sustain, a 6s auto reset that heals off the wave, not just off you. notes: Second worst slot-labelling case in my slice after Volibear: the content layer called the cage E, the heal W and the mark Q — every one of Yorick's three lane abilities was in the wrong slot. Chart edits are one atomic group of four matched pairs, all aligning with the packet chart and the existing prose.
